'''Joris''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3640 BBY]], he was the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of [[Darth Achelon]]'s flagship ''[[Carnage]]'', which engaged the Republic fleet in battle. Joris contacted the nearby [[Harrower-class dreadnought]] ''[[Doombringer]]'', which was used by Moff [[Valion Pyron]] to test the [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]] superlaser and requested aid.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Joris appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission.
